vb_textbox.text: Start with the same gnome each time, until the number of mushrooms goes down or that gnome is not available to chose from. I started with the one with the purple pointy hat and then the one with the brown pointy hat I then switched to the ones with red and green hats respectively, however the order may be different for you. A good yield is between 6 and 9 mushrooms, a low yield between 3 and 0. Be sure to hit SPACE only when the basket in the forest appears. If you hit it immediately after selecting your gnome, it will not register and you will eventually get a too slow message. Good Luck
